text:
maria: Quick QA — I'm trying to land a Terraform change that grants decrypt to a KMS key for the realtime-ingest k8s SA via IRSA. Plan looks fine but the apply stalls with a KMS error. Can someone eyeball the snippets below?

maria: Terraform snippet i'm applying:
```hcl
resource "aws_kms_key" "realtime" {
  description = "realtime-ingest key"
}

resource "aws_iam_role" "realtime_irsa" {
  # role created by eks module (IRSA)
}

resource "aws_kms_grant" "realtime_ingest" {
  key_id = aws_kms_key.realtime.key_id
  grantee_principal = aws_iam_role.realtime_irsa.arn
  operations = ["Decrypt", "Encrypt", "GenerateDataKey"]
}
```

maria: k8s SA annotation (for context):
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: realtime-ingest
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "${aws_iam_role.realtime_irsa.arn}"
```

ci-bot: plan: https://ci.internal/runs/1234 — apply consistently stalls at `aws_kms_grant.realtime_ingest: Creating...` then times out with NotFound.

alex: This is the usual TF ordering / KMS eventual-consistency thing. A few quick options:
- add `depends_on = [aws_kms_key.realtime, aws_iam_role.realtime_irsa]` to the `aws_kms_grant` (often enough)
- split into two applies: create key + role (and alias) first, then add grant in a follow-up apply
- as a last resort use a `null_resource` with local-exec to call `aws kms create-grant` after the key exists
small note: `key_id` should be the key id/arn (you're using `key_id` which is fine); ensure region matches.

ben: also check the alias path — I once had the key created but the alias created slightly later, and KMS APIs returned NotFound for a short window. If you're creating an alias, ensure the alias resource is created before the grant or reference the key id directly.

rachel: can you paste the exact apply error? AccessDenied vs NotFound makes different fixes.

maria: error copy: `Error creating KMS grant: NotFoundException: Key ARN not found` — it hangs ~4–5m then fails.

alex: start with `depends_on` on the grant. If CI still flakes, split the change into two commits (apply key+role+alias first). Also double-check the role ARN output from the eks module; sometimes the module output isn't available until the role is fully propagated.

maria: i'll add the depends_on and rerun. thanks. i'll split the PR if it keeps flaking.

alex: LGTM — after you push ping me and i'll review the PR. tiny nit: restrict `operations` to the minimum you need (eg Decrypt + GenerateDataKey) if this is only for data-key decryption.

maria: pushed depends_on and trimmed ops. pinging @alex for review.

alex: Reviewing now. Looks good, approving once CI passes.

maria: thanks all — will merge after green CI and monitor for any post-apply flakiness.
